reply_prompt: Keep replies concise. When it is simply fixed, reply with "Addressed", "Agreed, fixed", "Done", or similar. Use your judgment about whether more detail is necessary; stay concise when you add it. Never mention the fixing commit's ID or link to that commit. When referencing code, use a GitHub permalink pinned to a full commit SHA with line anchors, never a branch URL or branch-relative reference. Keep internal workflow details private.
